experiments.title: Mantaflow Liquid + Baked Deforming Cloth Effector EEVEE
experiments.description: A real Cloth simulation is baked to shape keys first, then replayed as an animated planar Mantaflow Fluid Effector while true FLIP liquid falls onto it. Coupling remains deliberately one-way from the deforming Cloth into the liquid solve.

experiments.title: Mantaflow Liquid + Cloth Effector EEVEE
experiments.description: Minimal true-liquid baseline: Blender 4.0.2 Mantaflow/FLIP liquid falls onto a red Cloth-shaped planar Fluid Effector. The Cloth is static in this first test; coupling is explicitly one-way from Cloth obstacle geometry into the liquid solve.

experiments.title: Cloth Drop on Jelly with Delayed Ball EEVEE
experiments.description: A free cloth sheet falls onto a Soft Body jelly cube, then one rigid-body ball is released exactly two seconds later. The simulation is baked in two stable one-way passes before parallel EEVEE rendering.

experiments.title: Soft Body Jelly Cube Ball Drop EEVEE
experiments.description: Three gravity-driven rigid-body balls fall onto a rounded Soft Body jelly cube. Jelly deformation and rigid-body transforms are sampled sequentially and baked before parallel EEVEE frame rendering.

experiments.title: Cloth Hammock Rigid Body Drop EEVEE
experiments.description: Hybrid cloth + rigid-body experiment: 12 staggered rigid-body spheres fall into a four-corner-pinned cloth hammock. A hidden passive rigid proxy provides stable two-system coupling while the visible cloth reacts to the moving spheres. Physics is baked before parallel EEVEE rendering.
